<div class="process-section">
  <h2 class="process-heading">The Certification Process</h2>
  <div class="process-steps">
    <div class="step">
      <div class="step-number">1</div>
      <div class="step-content">
        <div class="step-title">Submit Application</div>
        <div class="step-desc">Complete the online application form with your personal information, academic history, competency evidence, work experience, and professional development record.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="step-connector"></div>
    <div class="step">
      <div class="step-number">2</div>
      <div class="step-content">
        <div class="step-title">Pay Application Fee</div>
        <div class="step-desc">Submit the non-refundable application fee. Your application will not be reviewed until both the materials and fee have been received.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="step-connector"></div>
    <div class="step">
      <div class="step-number">3</div>
      <div class="step-content">
        <div class="step-title">Review by Committee</div>
        <div class="step-desc">A subgroup of the Data Science Certification Committee (DSCC) conducts a confidential peer review of your submitted portfolio materials.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="step-connector"></div>
    <div class="step">
      <div class="step-number">4</div>
      <div class="step-content">
        <div class="step-title">Decision Communicated</div>
        <div class="step-desc">You will receive written notification of the committee's decision, typically within <strong>8 weeks</strong>. Unsuccessful applicants receive written feedback and may reapply.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="landing-footer">
  <p>Questions? Contact <a href="mailto:certification@amstat.org">certification@amstat.org</a></p>
  <p class="footer-note">ASA membership is required to apply and to maintain certification.</p>
</div>
